03

Smart Money Concepts

Market structure

BOS and CHoCH show who is in control and when it changes.

Liquidity

Resting orders above highs and below lows. I track where price is drawn and where it sweeps.

Fair value gaps

Imbalances left by displacement, used as areas of interest for entries.

Order blocks

The last opposing candle before displacement, refined with lower-timeframe confirmation.

Premium / Discount

Look to buy in discount and sell in premium relative to the dealing range.

SMT divergence

Correlated markets disagreeing at a high or a low flags a likely reversal.

Trading approach

1HTF context

Start from the higher-timeframe picture.

2Market structure

Read the swings, BOS and CHoCH.

3Liquidity

Map the pools price is drawn to.

4Directional bias

Commit to a side only with structure, liquidity and confirmation.

5LTF confirmation

Wait for the lower timeframe to agree.

6Entry

Confirmation-based, never forced.

7Risk management

Size from the stop, with the risk fixed in advance.

8Trade management

Structured exits against predefined risk and reward.

Risk calculator

Fixed risk first, size second. Enter the trade and see the position size, reward to risk and what a losing streak would cost.

Trade setup

How it is calculated

Size = (balance × risk %) ÷ (|entry − stop| × value of a 1.0 move per unit). The size is rounded down to the smallest tradable step, so the real risk never exceeds your limit. Example values are placeholders, not live prices.
